presets.label: Image sizes
presets.help: Every uploaded photo is made in these widths. The height follows the shape below. A change makes every size again from the kept originals.

aspectRatio.label: Shape (width : height)
aspectRatio.help: Every size keeps the same shape, so the grid never looks uneven. 4 : 5 is the standard.

formats.label: File formats
formats.help: Each size is made in these formats. The browser takes the best one it can read. JPEG always stays for old browsers.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: 75–80: the eye sees no difference, but files are less than half the size. Default 78.

avifEffort.label: AVIF effort
avifEffort.help: How hard the server works to make AVIF files small (0–9). Higher is smaller but slower.

fit.label: When a photo has another shape
fit.help: Contain: the whole photo is kept and the rest of the frame is filled with the background colour. Cover: the photo is cut to the shape.

background.label: Background colour
background.help: Fills the frame around a photo of another shape, and behind see-through parts.

slots.label: Sizes per place on the page
slots.help: Which sizes a phone and a larger screen may get in each place. A phone never gets the zoom size on the page.

phoneMaxWidth.label: Phone screen up to (px)
phoneMaxWidth.help: Screens up to this width count as a phone for choosing image sizes.

maxBytes.label: Largest upload (bytes)
maxBytes.help: A bigger file is refused at upload.

minWidth.label: Smallest photo width (px)
minWidth.help: A photo narrower than this is refused, so the main product image is never blown up.

acceptedTypes.label: Accepted picture types
acceptedTypes.help: Which kinds of picture files may be uploaded.

mode.label: Where photos are processed
mode.help: Inline: right after the upload on this server. Queue: by the background image worker once it runs.

publicBaseUrl.label: Photo address (CDN)
publicBaseUrl.help: Where the shop's photos are served from, for example the CDN in front of Blob storage. Empty = this site. Your own data.

maxAgeSeconds.label: How long browsers keep a photo (seconds)
maxAgeSeconds.help: Photo file names change when a photo changes, so a long time is safe.

minimum.label: Photos needed per product
minimum.help: A product cannot go live with fewer photos than this.

requiredRoles.label: Photos that must be there
requiredRoles.help: The kinds of photo every product needs, for example front, back, detail and on-model.

frontPerColour.label: Front photo for every colour
frontPerColour.help: When on, every colour of a product needs its own front photo.

enabled.label: Watermark on download
enabled.help: A downloaded or saved photo gets the watermark. Photos on the shop never have one.

text.label: Watermark text
text.help: Empty = the store name. Your own data: it never goes to another installation.

position.label: Watermark place
position.help: A corner, the centre, or repeated across the photo.

scale.label: Watermark size
scale.help: Text height as a share of the photo width, in hundredths.

preset.label: Download size
preset.help: Which size a download is made from, for example main.

graceDays.label: Unused photo waits (days)
graceDays.help: A file used nowhere is listed as unused only after this many days. Clean-up moves it to the archive; it can always be brought back.

pageSize.label: Files per page in the media library
pageSize.help: How many files one page of the library shows.
